newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.040pts to 102.705.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.040pts to 102.705.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.040 points in Thursday's trading to 102.705 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.786 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.078 points to 99.686, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio lost 0.002 points to 2.398 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 3.229 points to 1,051.704.
